主要内容: SBA Communications Corporation, a U.S.-based company, issued a press release on April 26, 2021, announcing its financial and operational results for the first quarter ended March 31, 2021. The report included an update on its full-year 2021 guidance and the announcement of its quarterly dividend. The press release is included as Exhibit 99.1 in the Form 8-K filing. The company is listed on the NASDAQ Global Select Market under the ticker symbol SBAC. The filing is part of the company's regular reporting obligations under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934.
